dual_write_methods.non_strict_mirror_failure: primary write result is returned and a redacted mirror failure summary is recorded
dual_write_methods.strict_mirror_failure: primary write succeeds, mirror failure raises DualWriteMirrorError with a redacted error
dual_write_methods.file_write_policy: file-byte writes remain primary-only until a dedicated file-object mirror strategy exists

background_jobs.stage13_policy_reason: shadow contains runtime job history absent from the current primary snapshot; active or attention jobs would be mirror_write_required, while terminal shadow-only jobs can be retained or cleaned under audit
mirror_write_required_when: status is failed or partial_success and the job is not acknowledged or superseded
retention_only_when: terminal non-derived job is present in the active store
acknowledged, superseded, cancelled, or completed history is retained for audit
rebuildable_when: terminal derived job has source, affected_scopes, or affected_months metadata
cleanup_candidate_when: shadow-only terminal job has timestamp evidence and is absent from primary
blocked_unknown_when: shadow-only terminal job lacks timestamp evidence

app_health_alerts.stage13_policy_reason: current runtime health alerts are generated from live health state and must be mirrored during controlled rehearsal; recovered alert history is retention-only
mirror_write_required_when: known alert kind has status active
retention_only_when: known alert kind has status recovered
cleanup_candidate_when: shadow-only recovered alert is beyond the agreed retention window

notes: Stage 13 and earlier P0/P1 mismatches are closed.
Remaining runtime P2 domains have executable classification rules and local tests.
Individual stage13 runtime rows were not expanded from redacted reports; stage15 must classify live payloads in a read-only preflight before enabling any controlled mirror-write rehearsal.
